content: Common fairness-testing mistakes: (1) optimizing only for aggregate accuracy while ignoring subgroup performance -- a model can hit high overall accuracy while systematically under-triaging a specific population; (2) treating a single fairness metric as sufficient proof of fairness -- statistical parity can mask real disparities and doesn't diagnose root cause; (3) not stratifying validation by the protected attribute (building/seniority in this project's case) before deployment; (4) ignoring the sensitivity/specificity trade-off implications of fairness thresholds. Best practice: mandatory paired/stratified testing (identical input varying only the protected attribute) as a release gate, not just an aggregate metric.
